title: Paris on Fast Forward
hook: What if every price in Paris doubled every 3 seconds?

characters.name: Sophie
characters.look: a baker in a flour-dusted apron

beats.say: At nine, a croissant costs 1 euro 20.
beats.see: a price tag on a bakery counter

beats.say: By lunch, the same croissant costs more than a car.
beats.see: the price tag spinning like a slot machine

beats.say: Economists would call it worse than Germany in 1923.
beats.see: wheelbarrows of banknotes in the street

beats.say: Scientists say a human brain cannot count past 4 billion.
beats.see: a man counting coins, his eyes crossing

beats.say: Sophie just laughs and closes the shop.
beats.see: Sophie turning the sign to closed
